entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day,

the c  following:
 ORDER
They are heard and perused the case diary.

1] This is the applicant's first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.376/2022 registered at Police Station Y.D. Nagar, District-Mandsaur (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 302, 34 of the IPC and Section 25 of the Arms Act.
The applicant is in custody since 13.9.2022.

2] The allegation against the applicant is that he was also involved in the aforesaid offence wherein,
one Azhar @ Nandu whose murder took place on 12.9.2022, as it is alleged that on the said day, the applicant along with the other co-accused persons viz; Vishal and Kali @ Radhe assaulted the deceased with sharp edged weapon, as a result which, he died on the spot.
Annu Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113703948/
1 3] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the offence and he is 70 years old man and is lodged in jail since 13.9.2022 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a long time and it is also submitted that so far as the overt act attributed to the present applicant is concerned, it is alleged that he has assaulted the deceased with stick and kicks; whereas the main injuries have been caused by the other co-accused persons viz; Vishal and Kali @ Radhe, who were having sharp edged weapons at the time of the incident.

entities.text: Annu Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.

4] Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that one more case under Sections 323, 294, 506 of the IPC has been registered against the applicant.
It is also submitted that the age of the applicant has been wrongly mentioned as 70 years but, he is 60 years old.

5] On due consideration of the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary, considering the overt act attributed to the present applicant and the fact that even according to the eye-witness account he has not used any sharp edged weapon, this Court finds it expedient to allow the present bail application.
Accordingly, without reflecting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed.

6] The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
The Misc. Criminal Case stands allowed.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE moni Annu Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113703948/
